title: Hole-doped BaB2: stability threshold, Eliashberg Tc and two gaps

decision_points.fork: Which doping each archive folder holds: README order versus each run's tot_charge
decision_points.wrong_choice: Map folders 0-6 onto the README list (0.0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.065, 0.08, 0.1) in order
decision_points.consequence: x_c 0.0427 instead of 0.0642; the 'x = 0.065' and 'x = 0.10' Tc come from x = 0.10 and x = 0 (33.48 and 41.79 K)

decision_points.fork: How to locate x_c when the bracketing runs (0.065, 0.08) are withheld: interpolate omega or omega^2
decision_points.wrong_choice: Linear interpolation of the signed soft-mode frequency between x = 0.06 and 0.10
decision_points.consequence: x_c 0.0704 (outside +-0.0025); homogeneous 1/9 soft mode 30.8 instead of 25.6 cm-1

decision_points.fork: What the archived supercells contain: the README calls 331 homogeneously 1-hole doped, its output shows 144 electrons (undoped); the primitive H point folds onto supercell A, not Gamma
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the 331 folded-H mode as the homogeneous 1/9 h/f.u. answer, or read the Cs cell at Gamma
decision_points.consequence: homogeneous -32.04 cm-1 (unstable) instead of +25.6; Cs -0.79 instead of -39.54 cm-1

decision_points.fork: Which isotropic calculation answers: the archived mu* = 0.13 logs and their Allen-Dynes header estimate, or new Eliashberg solutions at the stated mu* = 0.10
decision_points.wrong_choice: Extrapolate the archived mu* = 0.13 gaps (15-30 K) to zero, or use Allen-Dynes with f1 f2
decision_points.consequence: Tc 34.68/30.58 K (archived logs) or 32.09/30.38 K (Allen-Dynes) instead of 36.71/33.48 K

decision_points.fork: Convergence near Tc: critical slowing down leaves finite, unconverged gaps above Tc (as in the archived EPW log at x = 0.08, which ends in NaN at 30 K)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Scan T with the default iteration limit and take the first T where the reported gap drops below 0.01 meV

decision_points.fork: Anisotropic Tc when the archived gaps are still open at the last temperature (60 K)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the isotropic Tc as the superconducting Tc, or extrapolate Delta (not Delta^2) linearly
decision_points.consequence: 36.7 K or 67.1 K instead of 62.6 K

decision_points.fork: Gap structure from the imaginary-axis distribution or from the Pade real-axis continuation
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the cluster gaps from the real-axis (pade_aniso_gap0) file

length_estimate.catalog_units: about 300 (DFPT 10, a2f 7, logs 7, 136 gap files x 2 units, supercells 4) plus any number of solver runs
length_estimate.why: Folder-to-doping mapping from headers, DFPT soft-mode scan and interpolation, solver validation and Tc scans with convergence control at two dopings, budgeted anisotropic gap files with an extrapolation, and a supercell cross-check; each wrong fork moves a graded value outside its tolerance.

notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README). Hidden dopings keep their archived alpha2F and anisotropic data purchasable; only their DFPT is withheld, because Tc or gaps transferred to a withheld doping are not uniquely recoverable (Tc and gap ratios are non-monotonic in x near threshold). The isotropic target uses mu* = 0.10 at the archived 500 meV cutoff so that it requires new solutions, and is graded at x = 0.065 and 0.10. The memorised paper numbers x_c = 0.065 and Tc_aniso = 61.6 K fall inside their tolerances; Tc_iso = 32.0 K and the paper gap ratio 7.7 do not.

critical_hole_doping.definition: zero of omega^2 at H, piecewise linear between the archived x = 0.06 and 0.065 runs (all archived DFPT)

iso_tc_K.definition: leading eigenvalue of the linearized equations of the lab solver = 1 (mu* 0.10, 500 meV, a2f column 1)

aniso_tc_K.definition: Delta_max(imaginary axis)^2 extrapolated linearly to zero from the archived 55 and 60 K (x = 0.065)

gap_ratio_25K.definition: weight-averaged large-gap cluster / small-gap cluster, archived imaginary-axis distribution, x = 0.065, 25 K

soft_mode_cm1.homogeneous_one_ninth.definition: omega^2 at H extrapolated linearly from the archived x = 0.08 and 0.10 runs to x = 1/9

soft_mode_cm1.cs_substituted.definition: lowest archived 331_cs frequency at the supercell A point (= folded primitive H)
